subject.title: fix(sessions_send): omit misleading delivery.status from async A2A responses (#96020)

question: Should normal async sessions_send A2A responses omit delivery metadata, or should OpenClaw expose explicit delivery-like status values for those paths?
rationale: Two open PRs fix the same stale pending-status bug with different user-visible response contracts, and recent main work still preserves accepted/pending semantics while adding delayed failure notification.

options.title: Adopt omission contract
options.body: Land this direction after redacted real OpenClaw proof shows async delivery is omitted and skipped-A2A still reports skipped.

options.title: Prefer explicit statuses
options.body: Use the sibling status-based direction only if maintainers define those statuses as admission or reply states rather than completed announce delivery.

options.title: Keep pending for now
options.body: Pause or close both contract-changing fixes if compatibility with delivery.status="pending" matters more than removing the misleading field immediately.

recommendation.title: Adopt omission contract
recommendation.body: Land this direction after redacted real OpenClaw proof shows async delivery is omitted and skipped-A2A still reports skipped.
